pages.title: Cover
pages.objective: Exact brand identity, document title, template version and approval status.

pages.title: Contents and status
pages.objective: Actual navigation from this manifest, scope, evidence and approval legend.

pages.title: Premise
pages.objective: Offering, audience, positioning, differentiation and values behind the design.

pages.title: Voice
pages.objective: Operational voice traits, channel tone, vocabulary and claims, with write/avoid samples.
prohibitions: no claim that is not in verbal.content_rules.claims

pages.title: References and evidence
pages.objective: Per-source observations, inferences, unknowns, reuse and privacy limits.

pages.title: Identity overview
pages.objective: Canonical identity, palette and type on one calibration page.

pages.title: Primary logo
pages.objective: The approved master, its exact text, contexts and placement.

pages.title: Construction
pages.objective: Real axes, boundaries and negative space of the master.

pages.title: Wordmark
pages.objective: Spelling, case, baseline and spacing of the wordmark.

pages.title: Lockups
pages.objective: Applicable primary, horizontal, stacked, wordmark-only and symbol-only lockups.

pages.title: Clear space
pages.objective: Approved clear space with correct and crowded examples.

pages.title: Scale
pages.objective: Approved minimum size and the mark at 16, 32, 64 and 128 px.

pages.title: One colour and reverse
pages.objective: Canonical silhouette in one colour and reversed, with pairings.

pages.title: Misuse
pages.objective: Labelled misuse specimens, isolated from the masters.

pages.title: Colour
pages.objective: Colour roles, approved values, allowed pairings and measured contrast.

pages.title: Typography
pages.objective: Type roles, specimens, hierarchy, licence and fallback status.

pages.title: Layout
pages.objective: Grids, margins, rhythm and responsive rules.

pages.title: Graphics
pages.objective: Original primitives, icons, patterns and density.

pages.title: Imagery
pages.objective: Subjects, framing, light, treatment, rights and privacy.
prohibitions: appearance is not a manufacturing specification

pages.title: Editorial and print
pages.objective: Relevant cover, spread, imprint and collateral rules.
prohibitions: no fictional client, contact or testimonial

pages.title: Digital
pages.objective: Header, avatar, social and interface crops and responsiveness.
prohibitions: a static preview is not a working interface

pages.title: Motion
pages.objective: Storyboard, transitions, continuity and the reduced-motion rule.
prohibitions: no claim of a rendered video

pages.title: Handoff
pages.objective: Actual files, formats, licences, tokens and version references.

pages.title: Release
pages.objective: Actual checks, unresolved decisions, approval and version records.
